status: post-hoc diagnostic specified while extension fitting was incomplete
purpose: Evaluate whether the participant-level stability penalty resolves the original G2/H3 failure.
comparison: Within participant aggregation, each positive lambda minus lambda zero at k in 4,6,8,12.
inference: Wilcoxon signed-rank, participant bootstrap, Holm over all 12 comparisons.
gate: Evidence of penalty benefit requires a positive mean difference and Holm p below 0.05. Report every comparison and any harm; do not choose a winning lambda for headline reporting.
